about: Photo look (house style for story and philosophy cards).

image.prompt: A small worn leather handbook lying on a stone step in an ancient Greek courtyard, early morning light.
A forest path splitting in two directions in dark misty woods, seen from above.

scenes.narration: Epictetus opens his little handbook with one simple split.

image.prompt: An open hand cupping a small candle flame in darkness, warm light on the palm.
Storm clouds rolling over a wild sea, seen from a high cliff.

scenes.narration: Of things, some are in our power, and others are not.

image.prompt: Hands writing in a journal by lamplight on a dark wooden desk, close up.
A lone runner silhouetted on a ridge at dawn.
A crowd of blurred faces in a dim hall, all turned towards the camera, shallow focus.
A kite pulling hard against its string in strong wind under a grey sky.

scenes.narration: Your opinions, intentions, desires and choices are yours to direct. Your body, possessions, reputation and job title can be influenced, but never fully controlled.

image.prompt: A man in a suit at a desk late at night with his head in his hands, face hidden, city lights outside.
An empty theatre stage under a single hard spotlight, rows of empty seats.
A cracked white porcelain cup on a dark table, side light.

scenes.narration: Most stress comes from treating the second group as if it belonged in the first: needing the promotion, the praise, the perfect outcome.

image.prompt: A craftsman's hands sanding a piece of wood at a workbench, sawdust in the light.
Two people talking quietly across a kitchen table in warm evening light, faces out of frame.
An open hand letting sand slip through the fingers into the wind at sunset.

scenes.narration: So put your effort where your control is real, like preparation, honesty and how you respond, and hold everything else more loosely.

image.prompt: A notebook page divided by a single pencil line down the middle, blank, on a wooden desk in lamplight.
Morning light through a window onto a pair of boots by an open door.

scenes.narration: Take one worry and split it into two columns: what I control, and what I don't. Then act on one item from the first column today.
